title: Shinonome Akito — Words I Never Thought I'd Hear〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: Words I Never Thought I'd Hear（4★）

rows.Line: Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Alright, so far so good.
The problem is the next part.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Not bad! Then, next...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He faltered a bit earlier when he was trying to get that new technique right...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But there's no way he'll keep making the same mistake.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (So, let's go!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Awesome! That was our best attempt yet!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, while that's still fresh in our minds, we should—

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Stop right there!
Could you all wait a second?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sorry for throwing you off your groove, but you should take a break. You've already been at it for four hours.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Really? We've been at it that long...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
In any case, it's break time!
I'll need some of you to help me bring the drinks I made over from the cafe.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: No! I'm so bad at rock paper scissors...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, if you're that bad, then I'll go instead...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Not so fast, Akito! KAITO's the one who said we should decide by playing rock paper scissors.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Let us know if you need any extra hands.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, we will.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, we'll be back shortly, but you have to rest while we're gone.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Luka
rows.Line:
We will!
We will♪
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How does your throat feel, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No problems in particular. How do you feel, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm also fine. I would've just kept on singing if MEIKO hadn't stopped us.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But to think that we sang the same song for four hours just trying to figure out those stylistic choices.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You spent a lot of time trying out different ideas. It's normal to have sessions like that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Exactly♪ That might actually be my favorite kind of practice!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it is pretty fun to experiment while trying to find the best way to sing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Still, despite this relaxed atmosphere, we've been having a pretty productive practice.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (The old me would never have believed this could happen.)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
The BAD DOGS, huh?
Do they really have what it takes?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: That new guy's pretty good and can sing, but he makes a bunch of little mistakes here and there...

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Their songs end up being pretty lame...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, we should get home soon. It's already getting dark...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, okay.
Sorry for keeping you like this. We've been at it since the morning, so I'm sure you're tired too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm okay. We didn't do as well as we hoped during that last event, so let's keep trying and make the next one better...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Back then, I sang because I wanted to show them all someday that they were wrong.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And Toya just kept following me without making a single complaint.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I thought things have changed a lot since then, but maybe they haven't.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Back then, and even now, I'm practicing because I want to keep getting better. I don't want to lose to anyone else.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I want to keep climbing higher.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And Toya's still right here next to me.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Akito?
You seem awfully happy for some reason. Is something on your mind?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, it's nothing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: More importantly, wanna sing for a bit while we wait for MEIKO and the others to get back?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are you sure? She did just tell you all to rest.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We've rested enough already.
Also...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I really feel like singing now for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, me too! Let's sing!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line:
Me three!
Me four!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What do you say, partner?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If you want to sing that much, then I'll join.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: As your partner.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Great, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Okay!
